tagline: Open hardware designed with agents, built for professional networking and ready to extend

items.title: Claim your badge
items.description: Arrive at the meetup and scan a QR code to claim your badge.

items.title: Show your profile
items.description: The e-ink display shows your name and affiliation from your AIT profile.

items.title: Show your role
items.description: The role bar lights up in your role’s color: speaker, sponsor, organizer or attendee.

items.title: Find shared interests
items.description: Affinity lights along the bottom reflect your interests. Look for similar colors to make helpful connections.

items.title: Keep in touch
items.description: Opt in to BLE and IR conversation detection, or use an intentional badge tap to exchange contact details and keep in touch after the meetup.

items.title: Return it or keep it
items.description: Return your badge at the end of the night to check out, or buy your own for experiments. Speakers could receive one as a gift.

items.title: Make something new
items.description: Flash custom firmware or connect add-ons through Qwiic or SAO.
